notes:
Shortcut fix: when you allow Accessibility while talk2me runs, the shortcut now works at once. Before, it stayed silent until you quit and reopened talk2me, while Home said "Ready". This happened after the update to 2.21.16.
Home: "Talk to me, I'll type." sits on one line with the Settings gear, and the cards start right under it. The privacy tag on the voice card stays.
Settings > Writing is shorter: Voice commands, Press Enter by voice and Write laughs and sighs the same way are hidden for now. Your choices for them do not change.
